phases.label: Reconstruct
phases.title: The task began before the work could.
phases.text: Find the run. Recover the reference. Rebuild the context. Only then could the investigation begin.

phases.label: Recognise
phases.title: The evidence changed. The same checks returned.
phases.text: Collect, align, compare, record. Too much useful reasoning had to be rebuilt for the next task.

phases.label: Retain
phases.title: Keep the method, not just the answer.
phases.text: Preserve the checks and their context. Make the useful sequence repeatable.

phases.label: Improve
phases.title: Use it. Find the friction. Build again.
phases.text: Real work exposed the gaps. Each revision made the next task a better starting point.

phases.label: Build
phases.title: A working method deserves a working tool.
phases.text: Software could retain the sequence. One practical need became one application. Then another.
